notes.title: Latest Game Updates and Enhancements
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Replaced in-game beeps with a music system; additional tracks will be added in future updates.
[*] Removed the frame rate limit for smoother gameplay.
[*] Increased shield longevity for better protection.
[*] Added slight friction to slow down moving crafts.
[/list]
